title.quote: Picture Cards Versus Physical Examination: A Proof-of-Concept Study to Improve the SOSAS Survey Tool

extractions.description: This paper presents a proof-of-concept study comparing the effectiveness of patient-reported picture cards versus physical examinations in identifying surgically treatable conditions in the community. The goal is to enhance the Surgeons OverSeas Assessment of Surgical Needs (SOSAS) survey tool, which assesses unmet surgical needs.
